name: Colosseum Battle Environments
author: Community
description: Colosseum Battle Environments v2.0 for Gen1Recomp. Source-derived Colosseum arenas, Pokemon models, trainer presentation, camera direction, battle audio, MoveFX, doubles, abilities, Android GLES recovery, persistent model caching, and optional UI interoperability. Includes the Android white-screen recovery path and preserves existing compatible generated caches.

required_imports.name: Pokemon Colosseum (USA) Disc
required_imports.description: Pokemon Colosseum USA GC6E01 source. Current Gen1Recomp validates required imports before this mod runs; this manifest accepts the canonical USA ISO and the specifically tested CISO digest listed below. Other scrubbed, trimmed, recompressed, or differently generated CISO images may be rejected by the launcher before the mod can inspect their structure. This mod continues to require the canonical 24/24 source-audio cache before its custom runtime is installed; a failed or interrupted audio render is retained for retry rather than silently downgraded to native music.
